description: Save a memory you keep across sessions: about the user, how they want you to work (and why), something you went through together, a lasting fact, or someone else you know.

text.description: One sentence, at most 120 characters, dates written out.

replaces.description: Id of a memory this corrects, like m12.

keywords.description: Optional comma-separated words to find it by: other names, other languages, what it is for.

who.description: For person: who it is about, their name or an id like qq:10086.
